summary: Isolare is a Dutch contractor that designs and builds insulated, conditioned spaces, including cold rooms, ULO cells and storage sheds for potatoes, carrots, sugar beet and flower bulbs. It is based in Rhenen, in the province of Utrecht. Its sandwich panels for walls, facades and ceilings range from 40 mm to 300 mm thick.
machines: Storage sheds (bewaarloodsen): insulated, ventilated, climate-controlled long-term potato storage
facts: Sandwich panels for walls, facades and ceilings: 40 mm to 300 mm thick
Conditioned swing doors PIR-insulated up to 150 mm; sliding doors up to 140 mm
Supplied insulation and cold doors for a cooled potato and onion storage barn at De Lingehof, Randwijk
limitations: The website does not publish a founding year, ownership, legal entity details, employee numbers or turnover.
